name: BVH with 8-bit Quantized Bounds and Indirect Interior Storage
aliases: bvh8-q8-ci (8-ary BVH with 8-bit quantization and compressed interior)
summary: BVH with 8-bit Quantized Bounds and Indirect Interior Storage is an 8-ary BVH layout that reduces memory bandwidth by storing interior bounds in a separate array and quantizing child boxes to 8-bit integers.
